title: A flat unramified morphism has unique infinitesimal lifts (is formally etale, hence formally smooth)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism] (locally of finite type with open immersion diagonal). Let $T\subset T'$ be a first order thickening of affine schemes over $S$ [def-sbc-first-order-thickening], with closed immersion $i:T\to T'$, structure morphism $T'\to S$, and $T$ regarded as a scheme over $S$ through $T\xrightarrow{i}T'\to S$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and let $a:T\to X$ be a morphism over $S$. Then there is exactly one morphism $a':T'\to X$ over $S$ with $a'\circ i=a$. In particular $f$ is formally smooth [def-sbc-formally-smooth] (the existence half), and $f$ is formally etale in the sense of Stacks, More on Morphisms, Definition 02HG.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 04FF (lemma-unramified-flat-formally-etale: 'An unramified flat morphism is formally etale'), with Definition 02HG (definition-formally-etale: exactly one dotted arrow) and Definition 02H0 (definition-formally-smooth: existence of a dotted arrow); [def-weil-unramified-morphism] is Stacks' unramified (Definition 02G4) by Morphisms, Lemma 02GE (lemma-diagonal-unramified-morphism) (1),(2)

proof.text: The open-diagonal instance makes f formally unramified. Obtain X′, j, s and its universal first order thickening property H by FormallyUnramified.exists_universalFirstOrderThickening. This is elimination of existence into a proposition; no new data definition chooses an arbitrary witness.
Apply flat_openDiagonal_conormal_isZero to f,j,s,H, then firstOrderThickening_isIso_of_conormal_isZero to j,H.1 and the zero conormal. Thus j is an isomorphism.

For any first order test thickening i:T → T′ and square a≫f=i≫b, the universal property H yields c:T′ → X′ with c≫s=b and i≫c=a≫j. Set a′=c≫inv j. Associativity and the two inverse identities give i≫a′=a and a′≫f=b. For any other d with those equations, FormallyUnramified.hom_ext with nilpotence witness ⟨2,hi.2⟩ proves d=a′. Restrict this unique-lifting statement to affine test schemes; its existence half is FormallySmooth f.

Proof written in 7 steps following the proof of 04FF exactly: f is formally unramified (02HE) giving uniqueness; p flat (01U9), q formally unramified (02HB); p^*C_{X/S} = C_q (04F9); C_q|_{Delta(X)} = C_{X/X} = 0 (04FA); hence C_{X/S}=0; then existence through the universal first order thickening (04FE (3)=>(1), written out as a step).
